message: EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLPOS END-EXEC (line 21, inside 01 WS-DB2-POSITION) names SQLPOS, which is not in the inventory copybook_registry (inventory unresolved_reference). Left as an unresolved stub; no USES_COPYBOOK or EXPANDS_COPY registered. WS-DB2-POSITION therefore has no registered fields and total_bytes 0.

COPY INQCOM (lines 15 and 38) and COPY POSREC (line 18) are placed under program 01 records (WS-COMMAREA, DFHCOMMAREA, WS-POSITION-RECORD) but the copybooks define their own 01-level records (INQCOM-AREA, POSITION-RECORD). Recorded as found; the holder record's total_bytes includes the copybook record's total_bytes, its inline_bytes is 0.
